description: P112 = E8 lines (lib.lines(e8_roots()) order) minus F0; P104 = minus F0 and F1. F0: the frame e_{2a} +- e_{2a+1}; F1: the 8 vectors listed (each is 2 x a root, i.e. a root up to the factor 2) forming a second orthogonal frame (author's #2338 / IDEAL h4 P104 unit). F0_idx / F1_idx: indices into the E8 line list; frames_data.py re-derives them from the vectors and asserts equality as sets.
